name: Shanghai Top Numerical Control Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Top Numerical Control Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of intelligent manufacturing equipment in China. It offers aviation and aerospace intelligent manufacturing equipment comprising computer numerical control (CNC) process equipment and five-axis CNC machine tools; compact general industrial five-axis machine tools; and large-span carbon fiber composite five-axis machine tools, as well as provision of repair and maintenance service for CNC machine tools.
